title: Moving Inventory Completion Report
subtitle: Household Moving Inventory: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Moving Inventory Completion Report covers inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement. The move coordinator records Household Moving Inventory performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Moving Inventory Completion Report keeps Household Moving Inventory exceptions visible until the move coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Moving Inventory Completion Report at origin residence, vehicle, storage point, destination, and room placement. Document inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement identity before Household Moving Inventory begins. Compare inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement findings with stated Household Moving Inventory criteria; route unresolved Household Moving Inventory issues to moving operations reviewer. For Moving Inventory Completion Report, confirm requirements for Household Moving Inventory. Ask moving operations reviewer to review Household Moving Inventory conditions beyond the move coordinator's role.

sections.title: Provider, customer, and service record
sections.guidance: For Household Moving Inventory, identify responsible parties, origin residence, vehicle, storage point, destination, and room placement, and the linked inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement source.

fields.label: Origin, destination, dates, and access window
Item, carton, tag, room, and declared special-handling identity

sections.title: Completion checks and remaining limitations
sections.guidance: Capture Household Moving Inventory facts for inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Household Moving Inventory completion checks
items: Item count, description, and origin room
Fragile, high-value, disassembled, or restricted handling
Carton, seal, tag, load position, and custody transfer
Delivery count, placement, assembly, and condition
Shortage, damage, refusal, or unlocated item

sections.title: Completion limitation, status, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Resolve open Household Moving Inventory conditions; have move coordinator assign the next Household Moving Inventory owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Access or weight requires different equipment
Damage or shortage requires preservation and escalation
blocks.guidance: Pause Household Moving Inventory when a prohibited-item, access, equipment, custody, shortage, or damage exception remains unassigned. Retain the available Household Moving Inventory proof and route unresolved inventory item, carton, room, handling instruction, custody event, and destination placement scope to move coordinator.
